title: Help expand coverage for treatment of obesity!
seoTitle: Help expand coverage for treatment of obesity!
metaDescription: Urge your representative to support expansion for the coverage of treatment of obesity.
excerpt: Urge your representative to support expansion for the coverage of treatment of obesity.
author: DrCurry
bodyHtml:
On July 21, 2014, Representatives Johnson (D-TX) and Blumenauer (D-OR) circulated a letter to their fellow members of the House of Representatives asking them to join them in signing a letter to the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) that encourages HHS to support coverage of obesity treatment services in state health exchange plans.

I encourage you to visit the Obesity Action Coalition’s (OAC) Legislative Action Center where you will be able to send a form message to your legislator in the House of Representatives. ACT NOW as the deadline for getting your member of Congress to sign the letter is Thursday, August 7th.

Take action by clicking on the link below, which will take you to the OAC’s Legislative Action Center.

Dr. Trace Curry

Take action today!
